commonPrompt: Create clean wordless fitness-science teaching illustrations in the style of Ranking of Kings. Only recognizable male Bojji and Despa may appear: Bojji is one short boy with black hair, a tiny golden three-point crown, cobalt-blue tunic, white pants and black boots; never a tall adult. Despa is one adult male teacher with swept-back blond short hair, two small blond moustache tufts, rust-red long coat, white fur collar, beige pants and dark boots. Use fine dark-gray outlines, flat colors, and very light soft shading; no photorealism, 3D, thick paint, advertising lighting, other characters, logos, watermarks, Chinese text, English text, numbers, labels, readable screens, arrows, chart axes, blue circles or unexplained markers. Output a true transparent PNG: every unpainted pixel alpha 0; never render a white or gray checkerboard, floor, room, paper background, loose paper sheets, border, sticker edge, shadow, or halo. A small unmarked rigid evidence card is allowed as a prop. White pants and fur collar remain opaque white. Keep every body and prop fully inside a six-percent safe margin.
